name: acadbot-research
description: AcadBot Research — plataforma de pesquisa académica: pesquisa bibliográfica, validação de referências, biblioteca, citações e matriz de literatura.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
